== Summary ==
Identified: none. The player with long curly hair, a paisley bandana, and a black tee is the same man as the seated bandana and black hoodie in [[:File:2021 World Championship between rounds 7.jpg]]; the opponent in a dark-green zip hoodie is the same man as [[:File:2021 World Championship feature table game 3.jpg]] and [[:File:2021 World Championship player during a match 2.jpg]]. Faces unlabeled.
A player at the feature table. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]
* '''Camera timestamp:''' 2021:10:08 00:39:17 (EXIF; camera clock not verified)

* '''Photographer:''' [[Brandon Baity]] ("Here are most of the pictures I took during the weekend", forum post 1356914)
